items.titleEn: The Saudi-led coalition has targeted the Yemeni port of Al-Hodeidah.
items.summaryEn: The Riyadh-led coalition announced it had targeted the port of Al-Hodeidah in western Yemen. Prior to the attack, Houthis backed by the Islamic Republic had threatened to bomb al-Hodeidah, the port of Jeddah and other Saudi ports in the Red Sea.
